description: Defines a Flutter widget screen for managing categories, including displaying, adding, editing, and deleting categories within a wallet application.

classes.name: CategoriesScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of categories with options to add, edit, or delete them via a user interface.

methods.name: _openAddDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog to add or edit a category; updates the provider based on user input.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including buttons for adding categories and a list of existing categories with edit and delete options.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Returns an icon based on the category name.
